gloss: to pull out; to extract; to remove

definitions.gloss: to pull out; to extract; to remove
definitions.explanation: To physically remove something by pulling it out of where it is embedded or contained.

definitions.gloss: to steal; to pilfer; to skim off
definitions.explanation: To secretly take something from a larger quantity without being noticed.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to pull out) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). The ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ component adds the nuance of taking possession of what is removed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out weeds
- ⟦{釘|くぎ}→釘：03881_kugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out nails
- ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out a plug/cork
- {抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: spot check, random sampling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pull out — simpler verb without the taking nuance; broader in meaning
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{抜|ぬ}く→引き抜く：17604_hikinuku⟧: to pull out, uproot — emphasizes the pulling force needed
- ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove, eliminate — focuses on getting rid of something rather than the physical pulling motion

RELATED WORDS:
{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (spot check, random inspection) is a very common compound noun in quality control and manufacturing contexts.
